verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a prompt cache on serverless. Cached input tokens are billed at a discount (default 50% of input on text and vision), and an x-session-affinity sticky-routing header pins repeated requests to the same replica to maximize cache hit rate. This directly delivers cost reduction on repeated context. Missing for 10: documented latency reduction from cache hits, details on cache behavior (TTL, minimum prefix length, coverage on dedicated deployments), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
